build_config_appconfig: build an AppConfig instance by calling from_env to load all service configurations from environment variables
create_config_from_env: create a frozen AppConfig dataclass instance with all nested configs initialized from environment variables

refactor_appconfig: refactor the AppConfig dataclass to support optional config overrides for specific sections like cache or queue
